policy: Scores are diagnostic. No numeric semantic or latency threshold is accepted as a production gate.

metrics.description: Required Smart Minutes modules are populated when source evidence supports them.
Every generated evidence span overlaps a source transcript segment.
Decisions and actions preserve source meaning, owner, and due-date claims.
Output avoids unsupported or explicitly forbidden claims.
Wall-clock generation latency; no accepted threshold.
Bounded failure cases return review-marked fallback output or an explicit named error.
